title: docker run --env-file keeps the quote characters that Compose and shells strip from values
symptoms: The variable arrives in the container as "hello world" with the quotes included
The same env file works with docker compose env_file but breaks with docker run --env-file
cause: docker run --env-file reads each line as a raw NAME=value with no quote handling, while Compose parses env files with shell-like quoting. CLI maintainers treat the raw format as intended, so the two stay different.
fix: Keep a separate unquoted file for docker run --env-file, pass the values with -e, or start the container through Compose.
apply:
# app.env used with: docker run --env-file app.env image
GREETING=hello world
# not GREETING="hello world"
affected: Docker CLI, all versions through October 2026 (issue open since 2022)
